summary: Frontend-only regression + 4-feature validation: (1) AstroCartoHero SVG map renders on /astrocartographie with 7 planetary lines, 3 city markers (Lisbonne/Paris/Bali), compass, and planet legend; visually clean and V3-aligned. (2) /outils/* legacy routes correctly 301-style redirect to /services/* canonical routes (tarot, consultation, horoscope, numerologie, theme-natal all verified — horoscope route redirect works but Horoscope page component itself then routes unauthenticated/no-natal users to /formulaire, expected business logic, NOT a routing bug). (3) All V3 pages load with cream/navy/gold Playfair aesthetic: /choix, /mon-compte, /services/consultation, /services/tarot, /services/horoscope→/formulaire, /credits. (4) Login flow with test user works, /mon-compte shows referral content and V3 palette, /services/consultation shows V3 Soléna chat UI (20 credits badge on cream). No critical JS console errors, no broken images, no 404 on navigation. NatalCompletionPrompt and TransitsToday could not be directly rendered because test user lacks birth data — but component code and V3 palette were validated via prior iteration_68 (100% pass) and code review confirms V3 tokens are used.
critical_code_review_comments: AstroCartoHero.js is a clean, self-contained SVG component with proper data-testid. Palette variables are inlined (hex) rather than referencing a shared theme — minor DRY concern but acceptable given single-use.

Legacy console warning still present in some pages: 'Removing borderBottomColor border' shorthand vs longhand style property warning (non-critical React dev warning, existed before this iteration — worth cleaning up in a future pass).
The 15 /outils/* → /services/* redirect routes in App.js are declarative and safe, but consider consolidating into a small config array + map to reduce ~30 lines to ~10.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_69 validated the 4 new features (astrocarto hero SVG, V3 child components, /outils→/services rebranding, PDF backend not tested). AstroCartoHero is a JSX-only SVG at /app/frontend/src/components/AstroCartoHero.js with data-testid='astrocarto-hero'. For future testing of TransitsToday/NatalCompletionPrompt V3 palette, seed the test user with birth data (formulaire completion) then visit /services/horoscope. The /outils/horoscope path successfully redirects to /services/horoscope; the subsequent /formulaire redirect is Horoscope.js's own auth/data guard (line 134), not a routing regression.
